title: Ikhweshine yeMpilo yoMguli - 9
instructions: Kwiiveki ezi-2 ezidlulileyo, ubuphazanyiswa kangaphi zezi ngxaki zilandelayo?

questions.text: Ukuphelelwa ngumdla okanye lulonwabo ekwenzeni izinto
Ingxaki yokulala, ukuhlala ulele, okanye ukulala kakhulu
Ukungabi nomdla wokutya okanye ukutya kakhulu
Ukuziva kakubi ngawe okanye ngathi uwile wena okanye usapho lwakho
Ingxaki yokugxila kwizinto ezifana nokufunda okanye ukubukela umabonakude
Ukuhamba okanye ukuthetha kancinci kakhulu abantu bakuqaphele, okanye ngokuphambeneyo ungaphumli ngakumbi kunesiqhelo
Iingcinga zokuba kungangcono ukuba ubhubhile okanye uzonzakalise
